column3: Brian's Lockup, southern Key Lento. Unlocked after Lab Fees (Chapter 1); unavailable after Chapter 1.

column3: Donnie's trailer, southern Key Lento. Unlocked after Clean Up After Donnie (Chapter 1); stops buying around Swamped / end of Chapter 1.
column4: Goods: narcotics LOW (better than Brian); jewelry VERY LOW; marked bills VERY LOW (early-bills eligibility disputed). Early best for narcotics before Tyrone; not an overall best-rate fence. column3: Watkins Auto Parts / Moses' garage, Port Gellhorn. Unlocked during/after Moses (Take a Vehicle to Moses), Chapter 2; remains available after story.
column4: VEHICLE BUYER: only accepts stolen cars without trackers; scan with WAiNK and avoid cars stolen near his garage. Best practical choice for ordinary tracker-free cars. column3: Dunk's trailer, Port Gellhorn. Unlocked after Slam Dunk (Chapter 2); temporarily absent in parts of story, later returns.
column4: Goods: narcotics LOW; jewelry LOW; marked bills VERY LOW. Best Chapter 2 jewelry option among the early buyers; Donnie also offers LOW narcotics but is Chapter 1 only. Later Vice City buyers pay more: Tyrone for drugs, Yasmani for jewelry/bills. Leave bags in broken-car trunk behind his trailer; delayed payout.\nCounty: Kelly.

column3: Tyrone's apartment, La Perle, Vice City. Unlocked after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3); remains available after story.
column4: Goods: NARCOTICS HIGH = BEST; jewelry MEDIUM = SECOND BEST; marked bills MEDIUM = SECOND BEST (behind Yasmani). Direct personal handoff pays immediately. column3: Yasmani's shop, Little Cuba, Vice City. Unlocked after Boobie Time (Chapter 3); remains available after story.
column4: Goods: JEWELRY HIGH = BEST; MARKED BILLS HIGH = BEST; narcotics MEDIUM = SECOND BEST (behind Tyrone). Pay immediately in person. Dye Pack Jammer/Credit Check governs marked-bills cash-out.\nCounty: Vice-Dale.

column3: Randy's garage / Balsero, Vice City. Unlocked after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), Chapter 3; remains available after story.
column4: VEHICLE BUYER: specific high-end cars on Randy's Wish List, including some with advanced trackers. Best outlet for accepted premium/wishlist vehicles. Moses buys only untracked cars; neither has a first/second rate for identical models. Check Randy's active vehicle requests before delivery; condition and trackers affect payment.\nCounty: Vice-Dale.
